_comment: Region definitions for the build waves (spec §6). Each region maps to one dist/regions/<region>.pmtiles. `sources` must all pass the fail-closed licensing gate (sources/validate_registry.py --require ...). `curation_mode`: shipped_filter (B, default — tile ALL legally-shippable trails, app applies fixed curation config) | baked (A — apply curation threshold at build time once a region is locked). `region_trust` feeds §4.1's regional multiplier. `official_whitelist_sources` are the agencies that publish ONLY maintained trails, used to build the §5 whitelist + phantom flag.

new-zealand.notes: §10 pilot. Best-provisioned country: DOC publishes tracks + PCL boundaries under CC-BY-4.0; LINZ boundaries CC-BY-4.0. Lean on authoritative directly, conflate OSM against DOC tracks.
